rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: ControlKeel sits between AI coding agents and production, comparing intended delivery against actual delivery to catch governance drift before it ships. The server provides policy validation, finding tracking across sessions, approval workflows, and immutable proof bundles for releases. Built on Phoenix/Elixir with single-binary distribution and integrations for Claude, GitHub Copilot, and other AI coding assistants.
